name: Vectrex
significance: Achieved authentic razor-sharp arcade vector rendering and introduced the 3D Imager, the first commercial 3D shutter glasses for a gaming console.

verifiedFactualData.gpuOrVideoChip: Vector generator driving an integrated 9-inch monochrome CRT

editorialContent.overview: The only commercial vector-graphics home console, featuring its own integrated portrait cathode-ray tube screen.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Achieved authentic razor-sharp arcade vector rendering and introduced the 3D Imager, the first commercial 3D shutter glasses for a gaming console.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: Analog joystick with 4 horizontally aligned action buttons
